name: Review route → APPROVED: publish the verify station (clean-room COLD verify of the committed artifact)
description:
The approved review route (design R1/R4/R6/SB3, group 5+6 — now a publish-triggered COMPONENT). When Quinn's submit_review mirrored route.review.verdict='approved' onto her review loop (the task measured green and she raised no findings), the VERIFY STATION component proves the COMMITTED artifact builds and passes its own tests COLD — in a SEPARATE fresh container over a fresh clone of the run's checkout with a fresh dependency cache (the third sandbox instance) — with ZERO model turns (it replaced the forced verify_artifact coordinator turn). Only APPROVED work is cold-verified. G2: this fires no lifecycle transition; the component proves + stamps verify.cleanroom.result, the delivery route decides.

R6 MECHANISM: a plain `publish` to component.verify-station.dispatch triggers the verify STATION component (zero model turns), replacing the forced verify_artifact coordinator turn. Emitted on core NATS (semdev's rule component declares no matching JetStream output port); a registered processor subscribing component.verify-station.> turns the reference into the cold proof.

TRIGGER = Quinn's review LOOP, keyed on the route.review.verdict mirror: route.review.verdict eq "approved" (required:false — the mirror exists only on a review loop, so it uniquely identifies Quinn's loop) AND route.attempt.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). Mutually exclusive with the changes_requested routes (07b/07c) on the single verdict value, and with the no-verdict park (07d) which fires only on an absent verdict. agent.run.entity-id ne "" grounds the run property (Quinn's loop was inherit-spawned, so it carries agent.loop.run).

WHERE VERIFY STAMPS: verify.cleanroom.result is a RUN-level fact. This rule fires on Quinn's review loop Q_n, so the run is NOT the dispatch's firing entity — it travels as the run_entity_id publish PROPERTY, and the verify station clones THIS run's checkout and stamps verify.cleanroom.result on it. (Unlike the floors station there is NO route mirror: verify does not repeat per-attempt in a loop, so no loop-scoped mirror is needed — the delivery route 08a/08b fires on the run's verify.cleanroom.result directly, R1.)

ROLE: none — a deterministic cold proof is a harness component, not a persona judgment (this is exactly why the forced coordinator turn was waste, R6). The delivery route (08a coherent / 08b blocked) then fires on the RUN reading verify.cleanroom.result directly; a "retry" (a transient docker flake) matches NEITHER route, so a flake never triggers delivery nor parks a good run.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps route.attempt.routed=$entity.instance on the review loop, guarded by route.attempt.routed length_eq 0, BEFORE the publish. A fresh review loop per attempt re-arms it. Shared with the other review-route rules (mutually exclusive anyway). The core-NATS publish is not deduped, so the marker keeps the dispatch fire-once under RULE_STATE loss.

metadata.station: verify-station — review approved → clean-room cold verify of the committed artifact (R1/R4/R6/SB3, group 5+6 component)
metadata.trigger_rationale: fires on the review loop's route.review.verdict=approved mirror (required:false scalar — identifies Quinn's loop). Mutually exclusive with the changes_requested routes (07b/07c) and the no-verdict park (07d). agent.run.entity-id ne "" grounds the run property. TOTALITY NOTE: the review route's coverage (approved / changes_requested / absent-verdict park) relies on Quinn's loop always being inherit-spawned (from 06a, and re-dispatched by 07b), so agent.loop.run is always present on an approved verdict — an approved-without-run loop is unreachable, and even if it arose it is fail-closed (the verify station errors on an empty run_entity_id property rather than verifying against "").
metadata.mechanism: R6: a plain `publish` to component.verify-station.dispatch triggers the verify STATION component (zero model turns), replacing the forced verify_artifact coordinator turn. Fires on Quinn's review loop Q_n, so run_entity_id travels as a publish property; the component clones the run's committed artifact and stamps verify.cleanroom.result (pass/fail/retry) on the run. Emitted on core NATS (the rule component declares no matching JetStream output port).
metadata.delivery_note: the verify station stamps verify.cleanroom.result (pass/fail/retry) on the run; the delivery route (08a/08b) fires on the RUN reading verify.cleanroom.result — a 'retry' matches neither (the verify station re-runs the cold proof via the base's bounded retry), so a docker flake never triggers delivery.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the shared LOOP-scoped route.attempt.routed marker, stamped BEFORE the publish. A fresh review loop per attempt re-arms it.
metadata.known_gap: general R6 station gap (honest): a persistent verify-component fault (after the base's bounded retry, or a persistent retry verdict) leaves verify.cleanroom.result absent/retry, nothing re-triggers, the delivery route never fires — no auto-park at M0 (R8/group 8).
